Subject: Post-call: plan for ML Ops review & hands-on session

Hi Jordan — great conversation earlier. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can lock the technical session with our ML/infra team.

Recap (60s):
- Primary goal: validate a production run for your inference pipeline (50–100 req/s sustained; 400ms avg p50 target, 200ms p95 target).
- Constraints: data residency + private deployment option preferred, sample model is a 7B encoder-decoder fine-tuned for ranking.
- Success criteria: predictable latency under synthetic load, KV cache behavior at scale, and integration with your KMS for key rotation.

Ask: let’s book a 60–90 minute technical runthrough where our infra leads (Rafael + Marcus) can walk through serving architecture, perf expectations, and run a quick smoke test with one of your sample requests. I attached a short discovery notes PDF and a brief demo outline to help frame the call.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 14 Mar: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed 15 Mar: 09:00–10:30

Please reply with preferred slot & attendees from your side (I know you mentioned Priya Shah on ML Ops). If those times don't work, tell me 2x windows that do and we’ll adjust.

Attachments: discovery-notes-20280309.pdf, redwood-demo-outline.md

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-call: plan for ML Ops review & hands-on session

Thanks Stephanie — good summary. Priya (cc) will join from our side and bring the infra runbook. We can do the 14 Mar slot in the afternoon. Prefer 15:00–16:30 PST so our EU folks can catch the tail end.

If we need to extend to 90 minutes, that’s fine. For the smoke test, we’ll share a sanitized sample payload and a small model config (only metadata) ahead of time.

I pasted a couple items Priya asked to confirm:
- Will Redwood be able to demonstrate KV cache behavior with a 4k context?
- Can we see a short run showing failover/fallback to a smaller model?

I'll wait for your calendar invite.

—Jordan

Subject: Draft agenda + prep questions for Acme session (prep)

Stef / Ben — quick internal note to scope the runthrough. Draft agenda below; attaching a DOCX with more detail. Please flag anything to add.

Draft agenda (60–90m):
1) 5m intro & success criteria (Jordan + Priya + Stephanie)
2) 15m architecture review (Rafael) — runtime, routing, quantized model support
3) 20m performance demo — live smoke test with their sample payloads (Marcus)
4) 15m failover & fallback patterns + security (Hiro) — KMS, VPC, audit logs
5) 10–25m Q&A + next steps (all)

Prep questions we need answered from Acme:
- Sample request QPS pattern and max observed concurrency
- Typical sequence lengths and token distribution
- Any model formats (HF/ggml/ggml-quant) or special ops we should expect
- Who owns KMS in their stack and if we’ll have a test key for the demo

Attachments: proposed-agenda.docx

I can run the perf demo if Marcus is tied up; Marcus will set up the test harness and share logs.

—Rafael
